# wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration (Resource)

Turns on organization discovery for the root organization. With discovery on, the login page sends users to their organization's login, based on the domain of their email address. Set each organization's domains with `wso2is_organization_discovery`. Each tenant has one configuration. When you destroy the resource, the provider removes the configuration, which turns discovery off. To import, use the ID `organization_discovery_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration" "this" {
  email_domain_enabled                    = true
  email_domain_based_self_sign_up_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_domain_enabled` (Boolean) Discover the organization from the user's email domain.

### Optional

- `default_param` (String) What users type when they choose their organization on the login page, either `orgHandle` or `orgName`. When it is not set, the server uses its default.
- `email_domain_based_self_sign_up_enabled` (Boolean) Let users self-register in the organization that owns their email domain. The default is `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `organization_discovery_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_organization_discovery_configuration.this organization_discovery_configuration
```
